Dev Arcade presents your portfolio through the visual framework of a classic arcade cabinet screen — neon-lit, compact, and arranged with the clear hierarchy of a game select menu. Developer stats, project links, and contact details slot into a tight, purposeful layout that borrows equally from 1980s arcade design and modern developer dashboard conventions. This theme suits developers who want maximum visual personality in a minimal footprint, delivered with the confidence of someone who knows exactly what they're putting on screen.

## Theme Overview

Dev Arcade takes the iconic visual language of the arcade cabinet display and applies it to portfolio content with precision. The layout organises developer stats — skills, project count, years of experience — as game-style metrics presented inside glowing panel borders on a dark background. Project access is structured like a game selection screen, with each entry clearly delineated and visually distinct. The neon accent palette — typically hot pink, cyan, and yellow against black — gives the design immediate visual punch without sacrificing the clarity needed to communicate professional information effectively. The overall composition is compact and deliberate, with no wasted space.

## Design Highlights

- Arcade cabinet screen layout with glowing neon panel borders on a deep dark background
- Game-menu structure organising projects, stats, and navigation with clear visual hierarchy
- Neon accent palette of hot pink, cyan, and yellow delivering strong visual personality
- Developer stats presented as game-style metrics for a playful but data-driven introduction
- Compact, efficient layout that maximises personality within a focused content footprint

## Who This Theme Suits

Dev Arcade is a natural fit for software developers, engineers, and technical professionals who love games and want their portfolio to reflect that honestly. It works especially well for those in game development, developer tooling, or creative technology, and for anyone whose professional brand benefits from a design that is simultaneously bold, efficient, and built with evident care for the craft.

<Tip>Dev Arcade's game-menu project layout is particularly effective for showcasing a focused set of high-quality projects — treat each entry like a game title card and give it a punchy one-line description to maximise impact.</Tip>
